name: ZOSU Wings
summary: Fly through spectacular levels to shoot down enemies and fly through obstacles, all while taking out bosses to save and liberate each region.  You are the famous ZOSU Wings pilot, and the Chobonator robots are attacking the ZOSU System.  Encounter 15 missions, from sunlit coasts and canyons to neon cities, ice worlds, volcanoes and deep space, and take down a giant boss at the end of every one.
